artifact_observations.reasoning: The background exhibits significant motion blur or depth-of-field blur. While this may be an artistic choice or camera effect, in AI generation, it can sometimes mask structural inconsistencies or 'melting' of distant objects. It is noticeable but not necessarily defective if intentional.

Some vertical streaks appear slightly smudged or painterly rather than sharply defined rock grains, which is a common subtle artifact in AI-generated landscapes, though it closely mimics natural water staining.
